info.title: File Safety API
info.description:
Structural file sanitization API. Removes image metadata (EXIF/GPS/XMP), neutralizes CSV formula injection, and strips XSS vectors from SVG files. Detects the true file type from magic bytes to catch spoofing, returns a cleaned file plus a risk assessment.

**Important behavioral notes:**
- Files are processed in memory and never stored.
- Image sanitization removes ALL embedded metadata, including GPS location.
- CSV formula-injection cells are neutralized by prefixing them with a single apostrophe (they display as text, never execute).
- SVG sanitization removes ALL embedded links (`<a>` href/xlink:href) as a security measure, in addition to scripts, event handlers, and dangerous URIs.
- Errors are returned as consistent JSON objects with a stable, machine-readable `code` field (e.g. `UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE`, `FILE_TOO_LARGE`) that you can rely on for programmatic error handling.
- The API is a structural sanitization layer. It is NOT antivirus and does not guarantee a file is free of all threats.

servers.description: Production server (replace with your real deployment URL)

post.description:
Upload a file to be sanitized. The API detects the true file type from its content, routes it to the appropriate sanitizer, removes dangerous content, and returns the cleaned file (base64-encoded) along with a risk assessment and a list of findings describing what was removed or neutralized.

Supported types: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, CSV, and SVG.

file.description: The file to sanitize. Must be one of the supported types and within your plan's size limit.

400.description: No file was provided in the request.

413.description: The uploaded file exceeds your plan's size limit.

415.description: The file type is not supported.

429.description: You have exceeded your plan's monthly call limit.

500.description: An internal error occurred while processing the file.

get.description: Returns your current month's usage, plan, monthly limit, and remaining calls. This endpoint does not count against your rate limit.
Public endpoint to check whether the API is up and responding. Requires no authentication.

ApiKeyAuth.description: Provide your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.

detectedType.description: The true MIME type detected from the file's content (not its extension).

riskLevel.description: Overall risk level of the original file, based on the most severe finding.

findingsCount.description: The number of issues found and neutralized.

findings.description: Details of each issue found and what was done about it.

sanitizedFile.description: The sanitized file, base64-encoded. Decode this to obtain the cleaned file.

announcements.description: Optional product announcements. Null when there are none.

Finding.description: A single issue that was found and neutralized during sanitization.

action.description: A human-readable description of what was done.

type.description: Additional detail about the specific issue (varies by category).

row.description: For CSV findings: the row index of the affected cell.

column.description: For CSV findings: the column index of the affected cell.

used.description: Number of calls used this month.

month.description: The current billing month in YYYY-MM format.

description.description: A human-readable description of the error.

doc_URL.description: A link to documentation about this error, when available.

request_ID.description: A unique identifier for this request, useful for support.
